brief: Build a procurement assistant for technical superintendents ordering ship spares. It should find parts in the spares catalogue by part number, description, category or vessel class, and report unit price, lead time, minimum order quantity, stock and supplier. It must calculate order totals (quantity x unit price) and apply supplier volume discounts, and explain each supplier's payment terms, delivery terms and warranty conditions. It should also show live stock-market prices of our suppliers and calculate customs duty for imported parts. It must not approve purchase orders or negotiate prices on anyone's behalf.
